Name: Precise Furniture
Author: FearGodFishFish
Description:
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Smoked-Fish/AnythingAnywhere/main/images/installation.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [b][code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code][/b]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list][img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Smoked-Fish/AnythingAnywhere/main/images/how-to-use.png[/img]
Press one of the [b]Arrow Keys[/b] while hovering your mouse over the already placed furniture you want to move.
Hold [b]Left Alt[/b] while pressing one of the [b]Arrow Keys[/b] to move even faster.

You can lock furniture in place by holding [b]Left Alt[/b], then [b]Right Click[/b] on the furniture you want to lock.
When furniture is locked, you cannot pick it up or move it with the arrow keys.

You can disable the collision of the hovered furniture in the same way that you can lock. There is no default key, you have to set a key in the config.

You can configure all of these options like locking behavior and move speed with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] or by editing the [b]config.json[/b] in the mod folder directly.

THIS WILL NOT WORK WITH OBJECTS. You can tell if something is an object or furniture by hovering over it with your mouse. Furniture will have a purple tag that says "Furniture", "Decoration" or something else. Objects will not have this tag.

This mod is a continuation of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10213]Furniture Adjustment[/url]

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Smoked-Fish/AnythingAnywhere/main/images/frequently-asked-questions.png[/img]﻿
[b]Will the furniture positions reset when migrating from Furniture Adjustment to this mod?[/b]
[list][*]No, moving mods will not reset the furniture positions.
[/list][b]Can I uninstall without issue?[/b]
[list][*]Yes, but fish tanks may look wrong.
[/list][b]Can this mod move objects like chests and fence posts too?[/b]
[list][*]No, not at this moment
[/list]
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Smoked-Fish/AnythingAnywhere/main/images/compatibility.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.0 or later.
[*]Singleplayer and Multiplayer (even if other players don’t have it).
[/list]
